text: {"lessons":["I let the account decline for several months without acting, so I should review my plan and risk exposure regularly rather than confuse patience with inattention.","Buying all five stocks only after the decline may have been market timing; future purchases should follow a deliberate plan, not a short-term move in account value.","The next month's rebound does not show that my purchases were right; I should assess each holding and the whole portfolio over time, without letting unrealized losses or gains dictate decisions."]}
